record.name: Advocate
record.description: Advocates are masters of argumentation and legal advocacy. They excel at defending others' interests, presenting compelling cases, and using the power of words to achieve justice and protect their clients.

progression_tree.description: You exude an aura of confidence and authority, making you a compelling figure in any social situation.

effects.notes: When you engage with others in a conversation, your charisma score increases by 1 due to the natural gravitation of authority towards your presence.

progression_tree.description: You have a gift for persuasive speech, making it easier to convince others of your viewpoint.

effects.notes: The Advocate's voice takes on a persuasive quality, making their words harder to resist. As they speak, the air around them seems to vibrate with conviction, subtly amplifying their Charisma checks.

progression_tree.description: You have a keen understanding of human nature, allowing you to offer insightful advice and guidance.

effects.notes: As you engage with others, your keen diplomatic mind grants you an intuitive understanding of their thoughts and intentions. Your Wisdom score increases by 1 during social interactions, allowing you to navigate complex relationships and make more informed decisions.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: A fierce warrior's stance, with knees bent and lightsaber at the ready
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A swirling aura of blue and purple energy, with intricate Force patterns dancing around it

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A majestic image of an Advocate in a heroic pose, surrounded by a halo of light
contextual_modifiers: With a gleam of determination in the eyes
Surrounded by a subtle Force field
